push.iosSteps: In Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. Open WickedHome from the home screen icon, go to Settings → Notifications and tap Turn on notifications. (Needs iOS 16.4 or newer.)
push.androidHint: Android: works in Chrome and in the installed app. iPhone: only in the app added to the home screen.
push.testSent: Test sent. It should appear in a few seconds.
